lines.en: I walk on the knuckles of my hands.
The jungle floor is soft.
I walk in the direction of the vines.
The silverback walks ahead of me.
I snap a dry branch underfoot.
Slow down; the little one falls behind.
Leaves brush against my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们沿着河走，好找香蕉。
lines.en: We follow the river to find bananas.
This trail leads to the banana grove.
My steps make the ground tremble.
Knuckles on the ground, I walk steady.

lines.zh: 丛林的地面我用手掌走。
lines.en: I walk the jungle floor on my knuckles.
Who trampled my grass?

lines.zh: 丛林的地，我一步一步量。
lines.en: I measure the jungle floor step by step.
Knuckles on the ground, I walk slow.

lines.zh: 丛林里的果子，我一拳一个。
lines.en: One punch each for the jungle fruit.

lines.zh: 手背磨得发热，我换只手。
lines.en: My knuckles burn, so I switch hands.
Looking left, right, wandering slow.

lines.zh: 这一路的藤，都是我荡过的。
lines.en: I have swung from every vine on this path.
Rain is coming; I need a big tree.
This meadow is awfully big.
The jungle grass is trampled flat.

lines.zh: 丛林里，我这膀子能推倒树。
lines.en: In the jungle, these arms can push down trees.
Stay close. Don't fall behind.
I tread on fallen fruit toward the deep woods.
Three steps, then I pluck a leaf to chew.
Slow down. The view is nice.

lines.zh: 我沿老路绕回自己的窝。
lines.en: I follow the old path back to my nest.
I sit and listen to water dripping from leaves.
I pull a handful of leaves for a snack.
The silverback dozes against a trunk.

lines.zh: 幼崽在我胳膊上睡着了。
lines.en: A young one fell asleep on my arm.
I tap my chest with my knuckles.
The jungle is always damp.

lines.zh: 有只鸟叫了两声就停了。
lines.en: A bird calls twice and stops.
I am counting today's bananas.
Sunlight leaks through the gaps in leaves.
My family is close by.
I chew slowly and swallow slowly.
This vine is too thick to break.
I look up at the treetops.
It is quiet enough to hear insects.

lines.zh: 我用后背蹭了蹭老树干。
lines.en: I rub my back against an old trunk.
I yawn and bare my teeth.
I sit with one sole over the other.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻手指，有草汁味。
lines.en: I sniff my fingers; they smell of grass sap.
A bug landed on my nose — itchy.

lines.zh: 我把背靠上树干，歇一歇。
lines.en: I lean my back on the trunk and rest.

lines.zh: 叶子落在我肩上，我没动。
lines.en: A leaf lands on my shoulder; I do not move.
I'm thinking of something important.
Time to move? Not yet.

lines.zh: 丛林里树叶一动，我就要看。
lines.en: A leaf stirs in the jungle, and I must look.
In the jungle, I thump my chest once.

lines.zh: 我捶了捶胸口，没什么事。
lines.en: I thumped my chest, for no reason.
Only birds in the woods, nothing else.

lines.zh: 我在等小崽从树上下来。
lines.en: I wait for the little one to come down.
I turn my sole over and look at it.

lines.zh: 有只苍蝇在我鼻尖打转。
lines.en: A fly circles the tip of my nose.

lines.zh: 我抓了抓下巴，想起香蕉。
lines.en: I scratch my chin and think of bananas.
A cloud drifted by.
You are standing under the banana tree.
Your hands are trembling.
I look at you, then sniff you.
You do not belong to my troop.
The silverback is watching; stay still.
Are you holding a banana?
Your eyes are bright, like a monkey's.
I come closer; you must not run.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像刚砍下的树。
lines.en: You smell like freshly cut wood.

lines.zh: 我认识你这样的走路方式。
lines.en: I know that way of walking.

lines.zh: 你如果再靠近，我就站起来。
lines.en: Step closer and I will stand up.
You do not look bad; sit down first.
What? I'm out of grass.
Halt. Name yourself first.

lines.zh: 我坐着，你才跟我一样高。
lines.en: I sit, and only then are you my height.

lines.zh: 那丛嫩叶，是留给小崽的。
lines.en: That patch of young leaves is for the little one.
Human, what's in your hand?
The silverback watches from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 你的手是空的，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: Your hands are empty; I am not interested.
Empty hands. Go away.
Do not draw that blade at your belt.

lines.zh: 这片林子，我敲胸口就算说话。
lines.en: In this forest, I speak by beating my chest.

lines.zh: 你踩断的藤条，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the vine you snapped.

lines.zh: 丛林里，我捶胸就是警告。
lines.en: In the jungle my chest-beat is a warning.
You struck me in the chest.
I grunt once and stay standing.
Thorns in the jungle hurt worse.
I shield the young ones first.
Blood runs down my arm.
You provoked the wrong gorilla.
I slam the ground once.
I retreat behind a tree to breathe.
Again; I am not serious yet.
My family will remember this.

lines.zh: 捶胸的力气还没使出来。
lines.en: I haven't even pounded my chest yet.
Ouch! Who did that?
I feel my belly; it is still there.
Hurts so much my voice shakes.

lines.zh: 这一下打在肋上，闷闷的。
lines.en: That landed on my ribs, dull and deep.
Two thumps on my chest, and I plant my feet.
I'm worse when I'm hurting.
The silverback beats his chest. Back away.
The old scar on my shoulder aches again.
My coat is thick; I barely feel it.
Bananas; I smell bananas.
Give me that yellow one.
Where did you get those bananas?
I will not snatch; hand it over.
One is not enough; I am big.

lines.zh: 吃完这根，我记你一次好。
lines.en: After this, I owe you one favor.
Do not wave it; it makes me dizzy.
I sit and wait for another one.
Bananas taste far better than leaves.
Pull your hand back and the banana is mine.

lines.zh: 我站起来，也没你举得高。
lines.en: Even standing, I cannot reach that high.
This sugarcane buys my company.
Another handful of this tender shoot, please.
grass! Coming through!

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的指节响一下。
lines.en: Each step you take, my knuckles tap.

lines.zh: 丛林里这一群，都听首领的。
lines.en: This whole troop answers to the silverback.

lines.zh: 丛林里捶胸，声音传得远。
lines.en: In the jungle, my chest beats carry far.

lines.zh: 甜味一到，我下巴就湿了。
lines.en: The sweetness comes and my chin goes wet.

lines.zh: 谁手里有草，谁就是朋友。
lines.en: Whoever holds grass is a friend.
I beat my chest; step back first.
The banana peel still carries its scent.

lines.zh: 你剥开的那根，给我半截。
lines.en: Give me half of the one you peeled.

lines.zh: 丛林里那股甜味，我挪不开眼。
lines.en: That sweetness in the jungle holds my eyes.
I wasn't hungry a moment ago.
You brought some last time too.
I sit and wait with my palm open.
Bumping me is like hitting a tree.
I step back and give you a path.
The little one is watching; I stay calm.
Your shoulders are so small.
I blocked it with my palm.

lines.zh: 我们只是碰了一下，是吧？
lines.en: We only brushed past, did we not?
You stepped on my toes.
I shift aside and the ground shakes.
Let us not shove in front of the family.
You are sturdier than I expected.
Who bumped me? Step forward.

lines.zh: 我这副肩膀，过藤蔓要侧身。
lines.en: These shoulders must turn sideways past vines.
You walked into the back of my hand.
This isn't a fight, right?
My palm is still pressed in the mud.
The vine path is narrow; go sideways.

lines.zh: 我是大猩猩，手背当脚走。
lines.en: I'm a gorilla; I walk on my knuckles.
You messed up my fur.
Two chest beats and you step back.
Ouch. My back.
I'm in a good mood. Forget it.

lines.zh: 我这身肌肉，撞石头都不怕。
lines.en: My muscles shrug off boulders.

lines.zh: 银背才有资格，我还没有。
lines.en: Only the silverback may; I am not yet.
I wait for the day my fur turns silver.

lines.zh: 家族需要新成员，不是我。
lines.en: The family needs new ones, not me.

lines.zh: 现在我只想守着这片林。
lines.en: For now I only guard this grove.
The leader decides such things.
I am not old enough for that.

lines.zh: 母猩猩在另一侧吃叶子。
lines.en: The females feed on the other side.
I do not compete; competition brings wounds.
The family line continues slowly.
We will speak of it after the rains.
Follow me. It's quiet there.

lines.zh: 我为你留了树顶最软的藤。
lines.en: I saved you the softest vine at the treetop.

lines.zh: 我在窝边放了一堆嫩叶。
lines.en: I left a pile of young leaves by the nest.
You look lovely today.

lines.zh: 你的毛上有晒暖的土味。
lines.en: Your fur smells of sun-warmed earth.
Come closer. Please?
My heart is pounding.
I'm glad you said yes.

lines.zh: 林子里的果子，够养一家。
lines.en: The jungle's fruit will feed a family.
This meadow is ours.
I pick up a banana peel from the ground.
I hold this piece of wood to play.
What you dropped is in my hand.
I set it before the little one.
Too heavy; I use both hands.
I will carry this leaf back home.
I sniff it and lose interest.
I set it down carefully, unbroken.
I throw stones farther than anyone.
This is a gift for the silverback.
This tastes pretty odd.
I pick it up, weigh it. Not bad.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，又低头找第二个。
lines.en: I pick it up and look for a second.
I stand in the middle of this troop.
Probably not food...

lines.zh: 我用手掌把它拨进怀里。
lines.en: I sweep it into my lap with a palm.
Taking this to the little ones.
I'll hold it for later.

lines.zh: 这果子滚到我脚边，归我。
lines.en: The fruit rolled to my feet; it is mine.
Dropped here, was it?
Someone is roaring; I heard it.
The silverback raised his head.

lines.zh: 入侵者站在我们的边界。
lines.en: An intruder stands at our border.
My hands are already clenched.
No one takes that banana grove.
The family falls back; I step forward.
I fix on whatever is moving.
The young are behind me; I cannot retreat.
The target is small but must be handled.
I turn my shoulder toward it.
There is a rustle beyond the bamboo.
This time I do not plan to be polite.
I watch to see who moves first.
The whole troop waits for my decision.
That sound doesn't belong to the jungle.
I catch the smell of unfamiliar sweat.

lines.zh: 有东西越过了我的地界。
lines.en: Something has crossed into my ground.
This part is mine. I'm going over.
Who's moving my grass?

lines.zh: 香蕉要到手了，我认得你。
lines.en: With bananas in hand, I know you.
I've got my eye on that way.
You touched my trough?
My knuckles crack as I clench them.
Target: the grass thief.
Today I'm not eating greens.
You have stepped over my troop's border.
You stepped over the silverback's line.
One chest beat, and you should run.
I follow you through the vines.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也快不过林子。
lines.en: However fast you run, the jungle is faster.

lines.zh: 我用手掌拍倒一丛竹子。
lines.en: I knock down a stand of bamboo.

lines.zh: 地上的痕迹告诉我你在哪。
lines.en: The tracks on the ground tell me where you are.
I do not shout; I simply come.
Can you hear me breathing?
There is only one path that way.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，不快，但不停。
lines.en: I go step by step, slow but steady.
The leaves are speaking for you.
I am blocking the river ford.
Do not hide in that banyan.
My shadow has covered you.
I stop in order to see clearly.
You have ten steps of distance left.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向，绕到你前头。
lines.en: I change direction and cut ahead of you.
The grass you stepped on is still springing back.

lines.zh: 我捶两下胸口，你就该懂。
lines.en: Two thumps on my chest and you should understand.
Don't run uphill. It's narrower there.

lines.zh: 我闻得出你拐了几个弯。
lines.en: I can smell how many turns you took.

lines.zh: 再退，你就到我家门口了。
lines.en: Keep backing up and you'll reach my family's door.
I chase and wheeze at the same time.

lines.zh: 丛林里我跑不远，你别停。
lines.en: I cannot run far in the jungle, so do not stop.
Hff... wait for me.

lines.zh: 我的指节压过落叶，很响。
lines.en: My knuckles press the leaves loudly.
Don't hide in the bushes!

lines.zh: 丛林里我追不远，但会追。
lines.en: I'm slow in the jungle, but I follow.

lines.zh: 我追不上，但我知道你的窝。
lines.en: I cannot catch you, but I know your nest.
I drum my chest with my fists.
My hooves won't stop.
You go around the tree; I take the vines.
The back of my hand sweeps across.
This one will lay you out a while.
I use my palm, not my teeth.
You were shoved into a tree.
I beat my chest, then struck.
Do not get up; I do not want more.
This fist lands on your shoulder.
My strength is greater than my voice.
You should retreat across the river.
I grab you, then let go.
This is the final warning.
I strike slowly, but heavily.
The little ones copy my stance.
Dirt falls off you in clumps.

lines.zh: 我抡起长臂，砸向你的肩。
lines.en: I swing my long arm down at your shoulder.
More? Let's go again.
That one's for the little ones.
You crossed my limit.
I beat my chest and the trees shake.
Hff... put too much in that.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领往外甩。
lines.en: I grab your collar and fling you aside.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍在你护甲上。
lines.en: One palm slaps your armor.
One bite, then back into the trees.
Don't dodge. Stand still.

lines.zh: 我在雨林的湿气里睁眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the rainforest damp.
Above me is a thick canopy.

lines.zh: 银背把我从地上抱起来。
lines.en: The silverback lifts me off the ground.
The first thing I do is grab a vine.

lines.zh: 这片林子有香蕉的味道。
lines.en: This grove smells of bananas.
My hands are strong, though small.
The family forms a circle around me.

lines.zh: 我从母亲的背上爬下来。
lines.en: I climb down from my mother's back.
Rain hits the leaves loudly.
I do not yet know who my enemies are.

lines.zh: 我的胸口还是一片黑毛。
lines.en: My chest is still black fur.
The trees here rise out of sight.
I try one thump on my chest.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片林有我一份。
lines.en: From today I have a share of this grove.

lines.zh: 我从一堆落叶里撑起身。
lines.en: I push myself up out of a pile of leaves.

lines.zh: 这片林子第一次见我的脚印。
lines.en: This forest is seeing my footprints for the first time.

lines.zh: 银背在远处叫了一声，是叫我。
lines.en: The silverback calls from afar, and it's for me.
First I learn to walk, then to get angry.

lines.zh: 藤蔓上还挂着昨夜的雨。
lines.en: Last night's rain still hangs on the vines.

lines.zh: 我握紧拳头，试了试力气。
lines.en: I clench my fist and test my strength.

lines.zh: 我从树杈上落到湿泥里。
lines.en: I drop from the fork of a tree into wet mud.
Who's drumming on the trunks in the jungle?
Who's my family here?
Is this meadow?
In the jungle, I thump my chest twice.
I straighten up out of the vines.
I'm Gorilla. Nice to meet you.
moo... my voice still works.
The sun is glaring.

lines.zh: 我捶胸的声音，传得很远。
lines.en: My chest-beat carries far.
Fire singes my fur and leaves a smell.
Stay back. I'm on fire.
I fell out of the tree.
That high? Why no warning?
River water closed over my nose.
Water fills my nose and I claw for vines.

lines.zh: 巨响把我掀翻在落叶里。
lines.en: The blast knocks me into the leaves.
My ears ring and my fur is singed.
An arrow sticks in my arm.
Who's shooting? Come out!

lines.zh: 奇怪的光让我的手臂发沉。
lines.en: Strange light makes my arms heavy.
Who's chanting those words?
The bananas are gone; only leaves remain.
My stomach growls; I peel back the bark.
Lightning set the dead tree burning.

lines.zh: 我的胸口，被雷打得发麻。
lines.en: The lightning numbed my chest.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，林子也消失了。
lines.en: The ground vanished and the jungle with it.
I'm falling. No bottom.
